name: CRM DBA Name - BNKM LegalEntityCustomer RSBL

content.query:
/* UAT: CRM DBA Name - BNKM LegalEntityCustomer */

-- #1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS [Count] FROM
    (SELECT CustomerID, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceCode, COUNT(*) AS [Count] FROM bnkm.LegalEntityCustomer_CM240_20240117
        GROUP BY CustomerID, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceCode
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) A

-- #2
SELECT COUNT(*) AS [Count] FROM bnkm.LegalEntityCustomer_CM240_20240117 
    WHERE CustomerID IS NULL
    OR FinancialInstitutionId IS NULL
    OR SourceCode IS NULL

-- #3
SELECT 'Source' AS [Table], COUNT(*) AS [Count] FROM busc.CRM_CORPORATE WHERE isLatest = 1 and isActive = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Target' AS [Table], COUNT(*) AS [Count] FROM bnkm.LegalEntityCustomer_CM240_20240117

-- #4
SELECT DoingAsBusinessName, COUNT(*) AS [Count] FROM bnkm.LegalEntityCustomer_CM240_20240117 GROUP BY DoingAsBusinessName
